Extracted policy statement

The committee reviewed economic conditions and developments in financial markets. Members discussed employment, household consumption and the outlook for inflation. This statement records the decisions made at the scheduled policy meeting.

The committee decided to maintain its current policy settings. It will continue to monitor incoming economic information and assess the implications for the economic outlook. Future decisions will depend on the full range of available data.

The committee remains committed to transparent communication. A record of the discussion will be published separately, including the considerations that informed this decision and the views expressed by meeting participants.
